comment: Release evidence corpus for the gte-reranker-modernbert-base catalog entry. Each score is sigmoid(raw logit) of the fp32 Transformers reference on CPU.
generation_command: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with transformers==5.17.0 --with torch==2.14.0 python bench/catalog/gen_catalog_references.py
reference_tool: transformers 5.17.0, torch 2.14.0; CPU fp32, eager attention, sigmoid(raw logit) of the classification head; bench/catalog/gen_catalog_references.py

items.query: difference between inner join and left join
candidates: An inner join returns only rows with matching keys in both tables, while a left join returns every row from the left table and fills unmatched columns with NULL.
